ranking: Fixed unweighted L2 logistic C=1 fits standardized encoded real training answers only. Rank whole questions by coefficient L2 norm divided by sqrt(encoded-column count), ties by questionnaire order. Refit within every inner training group and outer training group. Retain all dummy columns of selected categorical questions.
selection: Keep the current RF's recorded outer-training-selected parameters, High weight and augmentation ratio. Compare 4/6/8 questions and original .05-step thresholds. subset_f2 selects by inner F2/precision/recall/threshold then fewer questions. subset_recall_guard requires inner recall >= current RF's recorded inner recall, then minimizes FP and ties by recall/precision/F2/threshold/fewer questions. full8_control must reproduce the current RF. Inner targets do not guarantee outer results.
interpretation: Uses only existing questions, same full-eight synthetic pools and original folds; no new features or survey responses. Projecting a unique full profile onto fewer questions can produce repeated projected profiles. RF settings and subset selection reuse original inner folds; outer students are excluded throughout. Exploratory selection conditional on the current RF recipe, not an exhaustive search of all subsets or model settings.
